name: Dorian Russell
occupation: Executive Director, HomePlate Youth Services; Artist

bio.statement: Russell's pamphlet statement lists a background in scientific research, policy and civil rights advocacy.
bio.excerpt: Scientific research, policy, and civil rights advocacy.

bio.statement: Russell's pamphlet statement lists an M.S. in environmental science and an interdisciplinary B.A.
bio.excerpt: Environmental Science M.S., Interdisciplinary B.A. in science, economics, & policy

bio.statement: Russell's pamphlet statement lists service on the Northwest Regional ESD board and as past chair of the Hillsboro Library Board.
bio.excerpt: Board Director, Northwest Regional Education Service District; Hillsboro Library Board (past Chair)

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Russell says unchecked data center expansion comes at the expense of air, water, land and jobs.
positions.excerpt: unchecked data center expansion makes the rich richer at the expense of our air, water, land, and jobs.

positions.statement: Russell's pamphlet statement says the Silicon Forest has enough wealth to ensure every child is safe, warm and fed.
positions.excerpt: There is enough wealth, grit, and humanity in our Silicon Forest to ensure every child is safe, warm, and fed.

positions.statement: Russell's pamphlet statement says business leadership means sharing prosperity through living wages and benefits.
positions.excerpt: Being a “business leader” means sharing prosperity through living wages, benefits, stable retirement

positions.statement: Russell's pamphlet statement says local governments must comply with community priorities.
positions.excerpt: Local governments are the front line of democracy and must comply with community priorities

positions.statement: Russell's campaign site describes prioritizing community access to healthy food, clean water and nature.
positions.excerpt: fighting against corporate greed to prioritize our community’s access to healthy food, clean water, and nature.

collection_notes: Hillsboro's June 2026 candidate packet (T1) lists the seats up as Ward 1 Position A (Cristian Salgado), Ward 2 Position A (Kipperlyn Sinclair) and Ward 3 Position A (Olivia Alcaire). A June 23, 2026 city news release instead labels the Ward 2 and Ward 3 seats 'Position B'; the county certification and packet say Position A, so this is a city-side labeling inconsistency. Hillsboro news pages for Salgado's appointment returned client errors. Step 5 searches turned up older (2022 or earlier) Pamplin coverage only, not used. OPB (Sept. 2026) quotes him briefly ('And we’re in a crisis right now,'), not a position, so no OPB item. Seat holder per packet is Olivia Alcaire, so incumbent=false.
